candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record culminates in histologic findings of extensive lymphocytic infiltrates with epitheliotropism prompting hematopathology consultation, consistent with intestinal T-cell lymphoma NOS. Peptic ulcer disease does not account for the lymphoid neoplasm suspicion, scalloped/blunted villi, multiple jejunal strictures, mesenteric adenopathy, or the 60-lb weight loss pattern described. These are entirely different diagnostic entities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Peptic ulcer disease is a benign acid/H. pylori-related mucosal condition; the reference is a T-cell lymphoma
